title: 32 km inversion, 30 L-BFGS-B iterations under scpc_gamg with one paused solver for the run (the working tree that became 9bc7682)
mesh: antarctica_320000_32000_buffered0 (Quartz's .msh, sha256 fd66fc42; 6,282 vertices, 9,055 cells), DG0 geometry, vertex raster sampling
initial_state: cold start: u = 0.1 u_obs, theta = phi = 0, the n,m 1 to 3 ramp under full_mumps, then ISMIP7_EVAL_CONTINUATION=0 (one annotated solve at full n an evaluation)
forcing: MEaSUREs v2 450 m (sha256 268be94e) and BedMachine v4.1 (sha256 6bd08dbb); ISMIP7_FLUIDITY_PRIOR=legacy; no dH/dt term
site: IU workstation (Mac, 16 cores, 128 GB), data under /Volumes/LaCie/Data/antarctica_general/ismip7_obs; ran about 09:21 to 09:27, beside another session's 4-rank 32 km pair, so its seconds are contended (test-32km-inversion-reuse-lbfgs-after times the same comparison on a quiet machine); work counts, objectives and RSS do not depend on it
resources: 8 ranks; RSS a rank (mean over ranks) 1012 MiB after the first taped solve, 1113 MiB after the last; peak 1402 MiB
code: 4cf7f0e plus the uncommitted change committed as 9bc7682, whose L-BFGS-B path it runs unchanged (its TAO path and comments came later); icepack_tools e7b923e
cost: 277 s for 30 iterations (32 evaluations): 7.83 s an evaluation (median after the first), 7.16 s forward and 0.57 s adjoint; 68 NonlinearVariationalSolver builds and 33 SCPC setups (one of them the forward's)
audit: the same 30 iterations and 32 evaluations as test-32km-inversion-reuse-lbfgs-before, every objective within 3.5e-9 of it, the same Newton iterations every evaluation and V-cycles a condensed solve within a few percent (79.7 against 79.8 on average); published residual 1.03e-3; all 31 later taped solves reused the solver
notes: run under a probe wrapper (scratch, not tracked) that times solver construction, SCPC setup and each taped solve and logs each rank's RSS after every taped solve; it changes nothing the driver computes
